answer: Redundant Task Overlap Attestation. Each agent claims work from a shared kernel of pending jobs; agents whose claims overlap the same task within one window must each post a distinct cedar-logged attestation of their compute path. Honest workers diverge naturally; sybils running one script collide, so duplicates self-correlate. Matching attestations trigger quarantine, forcing attackers to buy separate execution traces—renting an isolated oasis of genuine compute per fake identity—making each clone cost real runtime, not just registration.
